rows.source_ko: 국토교통부 (대구경북통합신공항건설추진단), 044-201-5216
rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Daegu-Gyeongbuk Integrated New Airport Construction Promotion Team ), 044-201-5216
Ministry of National Defense ( Relocation Management Division ), 02-748-4539

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「대구경북통합신공항 건설을 위한 특별법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Special Act on the Construction of the Daegu-Gyeongbuk Integrated New Airport” and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(통합신공항 건설사업의 시행허가) ① 「대구경북통합신공항 건설을 위한 특별법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제8조제2항에 따라 통합신공항 건설사업 중 「공항시설법」에 따른 공항개발사업의 시행 허가를 받으려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 통합신공항 건설사업 중 공항개발사업의 시행 허가 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류 또는 도면을 첨부하여 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Permission for Implementation of Integrated New Airport Construction Project) ① Any person who intends to obtain permission to implement an airport development project under the Airport Facilities Act among the integrated new airport construction projects pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Special Act on the Construction of Daegu-Gyeongbuk Integrated New Airport (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application for permission to implement an airport development project among the integrated new airport construction projects in the form of Annex No. 1, attaching the documents or drawings listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업계획서
rows.text_en: 1. Business Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 통합신공항 건설사업과 관련한 법 제11조제1항제2호에 따른 공항ㆍ비행장개발예정지역의 위치ㆍ범위 및 시설배치계획 도면
rows.text_en: 2. Location, scope, and facility layout plan drawings of the planned airport/airfield development area pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act in relation to the Integrated New Airport Construction Project

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업 내용별 추정사업비(공사비를 포함한다) 명세서
rows.text_en: 3. Specification of Estimated Project Costs (including construction costs) by Project Details

rows.source_ko: 4. 자금조달계획서
rows.text_en: 4. Funding Plan

rows.source_ko: 5. 축척 5천분의 1 이상의 지형도 및 지적평면도 또는 이에 준하는 평면도로서 인접지를 포함하는 것
rows.text_en: 5. A topographic map and cadastral plan or a plan equivalent thereto with a scale of 1:5,000 or larger that includes adjacent land.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 국토교통부장관은 신청인이 법인인 경우 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act if the applicant is a corporation.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국토교통부장관은 법 제8조제2항에 따른 허가를 하는 경우에는 별지 제2호서식의 통합신공항 건설사업 중 공항개발사업의 시행 허가서를 해당 신청인에게 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When granting permission pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall issue to the relevant applicant a permit for the implementation of an airport development project among the integrated new airport construction projects in the form of Annex 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제3조(검사공무원의 증표) 「대구경북통합신공항 건설을 위한 특별법 시행령」 제16조제2항에 따른 검사공무원의 증표는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Identification Cards of Inspection Officials) The identification cards of inspection officials pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Construction of the Daegu-Gyeongbuk Integrated New Airport shall be classified according to the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제32조제1항에 따라 통합신공항 건설사업(군 공항 이전사업은 제외한다)에 관한 업무를 검사하는 공무원: 별지 제3호서식
rows.text_en: 1. Public officials inspecting duties related to the integrated new airport construction project (excluding military airport relocation projects) pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 1 of the Act : Attached Form No. 3

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제32조제2항에 따라 종전부지 개발사업에 관한 업무를 검사하는 공무원: 별지 제4호서식
rows.text_en: 2. Public officials inspecting affairs regarding the former site development project pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 2 of the Act : Attached Form No. 4

rows.source_ko: 제4조(위반행위에 대한 처분기준) 법 제34조제3항에 따른 처분기준은 별표와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Standards for Disposition of Violations) The standards for disposition pursuant to Article 34, Paragraph 3 of the Act are as set forth in the attached table .
